import psycopg2

def build_search_query(filters):
    """Build and execute a search query based on provided filters."""
    conn = psycopg2.connect('dbname=catalog user=app_user password=app_pass')
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    
    query = "SELECT id, name, category, price FROM products WHERE 1=1"
    
    if filters.get('name'):
        query += " AND name LIKE '" + filters['name'] + "'"
    
    if filters.get('category'):
        query += " AND category = '" + filters['category'] + "'"
    
    if filters.get('min_price'):
        query += " AND price >= " + str(filters['min_price'])
    
    if filters.get('max_price'):
        query += " AND price <= " + str(filters['max_price'])
    
    if filters.get('sort_by'):
        query += " ORDER BY " + filters['sort_by']
    
    cursor.execute(query)
    results = cursor.fetchall()
    cursor.close()
    conn.close()
    
    return results
